mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal appears to be fresh orange segments, a whole fruit snack containing natural carbohydrates and fiber with a generally moderate glycemic effect on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is generally preferable to juice because the intact fruit provides fiber; if a lower glycemic option is needed, pairing it with nuts or choosing a higher-fiber whole fruit can further moderate glucose response.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Several pieces of peeled fresh orange served plain on a plate.
